patterns.config_pattern: Next.js configuration uses TypeScript with type NextConfig from 'next'
patterns.security_headers_pattern: Security headers are configured in the headers() async function that returns an array of header objects
patterns.header_format: Each header object contains source (route pattern) and headers array with key-value pairs

existing_implementations.description: The spec indicates that next.config.ts already has a security headers configuration, but is missing the Strict-Transport-Security header

security_context.rationale: HSTS prevents protocol downgrade attacks and cookie hijacking, critical for SaaS platform handling authentication and business data

hsts_recommendation.reason: 1 year max-age with includeSubDomains is industry standard; preload requires careful consideration and domain-wide HTTPS
